Here is an impressive one-shot result from Fable 5.1: "build out at least 8 games based on Edgar Allen Poe. they should all be great and very distinctive"

The games are surprisingly different, fun to play and evocative, and some are actually a bit creepy https://poe-arcade.netlify.app/index.html

It took the request for distinctive games seriously, each used a different approach.

Open source, so feel free to modify: https://github.com/emollick/poe-arcade

This is both an interesting experiment and a sign of a tsunami coming for academia. AIs retroactively reading the research and finding both opportunities and issues with published papers, then sharing those judgements publicly. https://d3jhl7jsny6f2h.cloudfront.net/

@emollick I had it preordered since June but recently got a notice from Amazon that simply said "Your order of Co-Existence has been canceled" with no explanation or further info about how to order again, etc. Any clue as to what might've gone wrong?
